records.subject: Finance and Insurance
records.title: Official Foreign Reserves (End Of Period), Monthly
records.footnote: Prior to May 1999, Singapore's Official Foreign Reserves (OFR) were valued at book cost.  With effect from May 1999, the book value of foreign reserve assets are translated at market exchange rates prevailing at the end of each reporting month.

row.footnote: Decline in July 1998 was due to short-term swap operations to mop up excess liquidity in the banking system, arising from the reduction in banks' minimum cash balances with MAS, by 3% of their liabilities base, effective 2nd July 1998.
Singapore received its first allocation of special drawing rights in January 1979.
